name: Do I need to do anything to prepare my home before the painters arrive?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to do anything to prepare my home before the painters arrive?

acceptedAnswer.text: While our team handles most of the preparation, a few steps from your side can help ensure a smooth and efficient painting process. We recommend removing small, fragile, or valuable items from the rooms to be painted. Clearing shelves, taking down wall hangings, and storing personal items in another room is also helpful. We will move larger furniture to the center of the room and cover it, but clearing pathways helps our team work effectively.
acceptedAnswer.description: Before painters arrive, remove small, fragile items, clear shelves, and take down wall hangings. We will handle moving and covering larger furniture.
